saw_lines: Furniture buyers research for weeks, then choose a mattress by feel, firmness and whether it arrives easily.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening line, where a buyer decides if this mattress is worth a click.
Your 3 copy ads all run one identical text, so buyers see the same opener again and again. Keep the body copy, change the opening line and creative in each.
ads_1: Test delivery and price openers, plus three filmed bedroom stories, against the factory story
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram, your two linked channels
